items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think William Faulkner used to go in there.

ctx.x: I think William Faulkner used to go in there.

Well, they had their fathers, you see. Those people used to follow Steve all over. And anywhere Steve would be when they got ready for a party, so there was a bunch out having a good time, they'd search up for Steve. And they knew Steve's headquarters. The entertainers, the humming boys, the B-25s, were by the Waggon Top for the Astoria. They would go over these places and search for Steve.
